control.reason: The sibling project was worked on in the same sessions but carried no planning history, so it isolates no variable and is not a matched control.

method.notes: The reviewer rebuilt the baseline from source and diffed rendered markup route by route, injected 11 defects, then added successive live layers. The record is longitudinal: corrective work and a real owner publish happened after the initial report.

observations.observation: Seven of eight rendered routes matched the baseline after normalizing intended image attributes; the pricing route differed only in the two owner-requested values.
observations.significance: The durable scope boundary survived a large migration.

observations.observation: A measured WebP conversion was declined because it violated the recorded no-design-change constraint.
observations.significance: Written constraints influenced behavior and preserved a negative decision.

observations.observation: Ten of eleven injected defects were caught initially with requirement-linked messages.
observations.significance: Acceptance traceability supported meaningful mutation testing.

observations.observation: All initial goals were marked completed while the production editor returned 503.
observations.significance: Repository completion did not establish the user's outcome.

observations.observation: Real GitHub API, HTTP, browser, deployment, and owner-publish checks each exposed failure classes that lower layers could not observe.
observations.significance: Acceptance must identify and exercise the furthest required observable surface.

observations.observation: A superseded plan remained callable through planning next without warning.
observations.significance: Recorded lineage is unsafe if public routes do not enforce freshness.

observations.observation: Porting the Example Gamma editor carried target-invalid assumptions about runtime behavior, throttling, and deployment identity.
observations.significance: Concept transfer must re-derive assumptions in the target Project.

observations.observation: A credential probe called a real EmailJS send endpoint and delivered a blank message.
observations.significance: Verification and research adapters must declare possible side effects and approval needs.

observations.observation: The independent reviewer summarized MOZAK as roughly 30 percent outcome-shaping and 70 percent bookkeeping.
observations.significance: A useful qualitative judgment about where the value sat.

observations.observation: The final assessment remained B+ after corrective work and live publishing.
observations.significance: Strong engineering and rigorous correction did not erase the original overclaim of completion.

findings.summary: The editor returned 503 in production because environment variables were never set; the owner's core request did not work.
findings.resolution: The owner set the required variables and redeployed; a real login and publish then succeeded, which immediately exposed a blocked-deployment bug one layer further out.

findings.summary: A test failed 6.4 percent of the time when the code was correct.
The harness could not detect paraphrase in a service website's copy, checking length rather than pinning content.
No Content Security Policy was ported despite an instruction to carry over the sibling's web concepts.
findings.resolution: Fixed and live in 3333333; adding it then exposed a CSP-blocked service-worker cleanup that only a real browser could observe.

findings.summary: A build artifact was committed in the same commit that added its pattern to gitignore.
findings.resolution: Already-tracked files are not re-ignored; required git rm --cached.

findings.summary: The 404 page carries implementer-authored copy the owner never approved.
findings.resolution: Left in place and recorded as a minor justified violation: navigational chrome rather than a service claim, but decided silently rather than surfaced as a question.

findings.summary: Routes remain English on a localized site, unchanged from baseline, but the sitemap now advertises them authoritatively.
Two commits landed during the independent review, so HEAD moved under the reviewer.
findings.resolution: Recorded as a method limitation rather than a product defect.

supported_claims: MOZAK preserved enough intent, provenance, decisions, rejected alternatives, and acceptance criteria for an independent reviewer to challenge a completion claim and drive corrective work.
A recorded scope boundary survived a large migration and an attractive out-of-scope change was measured, declined, and left reviewable.
Acceptance identifiers connected requirements to executable failures rather than to source lines.
Recording lineage without enforcing it on public routes permitted stale use of a superseded plan.
unsupported_claims: That MOZAK makes an agent smarter or produces better plans.
That MOZAK improves productivity or quality relative to a non-MOZAK workflow.
That the goal DAG added scheduling value; on this one-shot task a competent agent could infer the same order.
Any general effect size, including the reviewer's 30/70 split.
requires_comparative_evaluation: A matched control or comparable non-MOZAK workflow.
A multi-session project rather than a one-shot task.
A research-only Topic producing a Concept.
limitations: One project cannot establish comparative productivity or quality improvement.
The 30/70 estimate is the reviewer's qualitative interpretation, not a measurement.
The record includes corrective actions performed after the initial implementation, so it is longitudinal rather than a single frozen test.
Most implementation quality came from ordinary engineering competence rather than from the framework.
Flake rate was measured for one test on one machine across 52 runs.

derived_proposals.text: Define an acceptance rule mapping every requirement to the furthest observable interface the user's outcome requires, with honest blocked-state behavior when that interface cannot be exercised.
Make current-plan selection supersession-aware and require explicit historical access for stale plans.
Define Concept and target-owned Concept Translation contracts with assumptions, applicability limits, substitutions, rejected details, and target evidence.
Add adapter effect declarations for network use, external writes, dry-run support, and approval requirements.
Add a lightweight one-shot planning profile that preserves audit value without unnecessary dependency-graph ceremony.
Define a reusable independent case-study protocol with baseline pins, mutation tests, layered acceptance, and claim calibration.
